summary.text: Kendra Penry is a nonprofit executive director and the Democratic candidate for the Utah House of Representatives, District 5, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where the incumbent is Republican Casey Snider.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has served in nonprofits for more than 20 years, most recently as executive director of a nature center.

paragraphs.text: Kendra Penry graduated from High Point Central High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Hollins University in 2004 and a graduate degree from The George Washington University in 2008.
In her Ballotpedia survey, she said she has volunteered as a Court Appointed Special Advocate and as a high school tennis coach.

She said she is running to listen to residents of the district and advocate for them, and that a vibrant economy, a strong education system, access to physical and mental health services and preservation of the natural world are linked.
